name: 64108 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64108 (Kansas City) has 232 nonprofit organizations. 122 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 102 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64108 (Kansas City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64108 (Kansas City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.4 times the typical level).
